title: The AI Accountability Ecosystem in the Era of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.12320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This article reviews and updates the framework for accountability in AI based on account- ability ecosystems. We update the framework in light of the latest developments since the release of Large Language Models for general public use. We propose three interlinked updates to the original AI accountability ecosystem: (i) reorienting the accountability ecosystem to AI infrastructure and supply chains, (ii) providing greater emphasis on outcomes monitoring and identification of issues that support decentralized system improvement, and (iii) incorporating end-user accountability given the new risks of unpredictability of language models in-the-wild. Collectively, these updates mark a shift towards accountability as distributed, continuous, and institutionalized, away from a system in which frontier AI applications can be modeled as discrete products controlled by single identifiable actors with industry-specific oversight.

translated_title: 语言模型时代的人工智能问责生态系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12320v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文回顾并更新了基于问责生态系统的人工智能问责框架。我们根据大型语言模型向公众发布以来的最新发展对该框架进行了更新。我们提出了对原始人工智能问责生态系统的三项相互关联的更新：（i）将问责生态系统重新定位到人工智能基础设施和供应链上，（ii）更加强调结果监测和问题识别，以支持分散化的系统改进，以及（iii）鉴于语言模型在野外环境中不可预测性的新风险，纳入最终用户问责。总体而言，这些更新标志着问责制向分布式、持续性和制度化的方向转变，远离了前沿人工智能应用可以被建模为由单一可识别行为者控制且受行业特定监督的离散产品的体系。
tldr: 本文提出了对人工智能问责生态系统的三项关键更新，强调问责制向分布式、持续性和制度化转变，以应对语言模型时代的新挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three key updates to the AI accountability ecosystem, emphasizing a shift towards distributed, continuous, and institutionalized accountability to address new challenges in the era of language models.
